_comment: Packs for the le / la trainer (/articles), see src/lib/artikelPacks.js. `topics` groups the lexicon's own unit topics (src/content/lexicon/*.json; the topic ids stayed German) into everyday packs; a noun belongs to the pack of its FIRST topic, so every tagged noun is in exactly one. `rules` are gender patterns, checked in this order on the noun's first word; a noun joins a rule pack only if it matches the pattern AND its real gender is the pack's (`article` le = masculine, la = feminine; an elided noun, l'école, is asked with un / une and counts by its genus). The ones that match and break it are the exceptions (la plage, le musée, l'eau). `suffixes` are endings. Hyphenated compounds (le porte-monnaie, le rez-de-chaussée) and acronyms (la CAF, le RIB) follow no ending rule and are skipped by the code; `noRule` lists other set phrases by lemma. `min` lowers minPack for a rule with few nouns.
_noRule: Past participles used as nouns (un invité, une invitée) are not -té nouns of quality: their article follows the person or the thing, so no ending rule speaks about them.
_levels: A topic pack's `levels` renames it per level: one lexicon topic holds different nouns at each level (A1 wohnen = kitchen, bathroom; A2 = deposit, landlord), so no pack name repeats across A1–B2. `name`/`icon` are the fallback.

rules.name: -tion and -sion
rules.rule: Nouns in -tion and -sion are feminine: la station, la question, la télévision, une information (l'information).
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -tion or -sion? Then it is “la”: la question.

rules.name: -té
rules.rule: Nouns in -té that name a quality or an idea are feminine: la santé, la liberté, la société, une université (l'université). The ones to watch: le côté, le comité, un été (l'été).
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -té? Then it is usually “la”: la santé.

rules.name: -ette
rules.rule: Nouns in -ette are feminine: la cigarette, la fourchette, la recette, une assiette (l'assiette). The one to watch: le squelette.
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -ette? Then it is “la”: la fourchette.

rules.name: -ure
rules.rule: Most nouns in -ure are feminine: la voiture, la facture, la culture, une ouverture (l'ouverture).
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -ure? Then it is usually “la”: la voiture.

rules.name: -ence and -ance
rules.rule: Nouns in -ence and -ance are feminine: la chance, la naissance, la différence, une urgence (l'urgence). The one to watch: le silence.
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -ence or -ance? Then it is usually “la”: la chance.

rules.name: -ée
rules.rule: Most nouns in -ée are feminine: la journée, la soirée, une année (l'année), une entrée (l'entrée). The ones to watch: le musée, le lycée.
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -ée? Then it is usually “la”: la journée.

rules.name: -ie
rules.rule: Most nouns in -ie are feminine: la vie, la pharmacie, la boulangerie, la maladie. The one to watch: un incendie (l'incendie).
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -ie? Then it is usually “la”: la pharmacie.

rules.name: -age
rules.rule: Most nouns in -age are masculine: le fromage, le voyage, le garage, le message. The ones to watch: la plage, la page, la cage, une image (l'image).
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -age? Then it is usually “le”: le fromage.

rules.name: -ment
rules.rule: Nouns in -ment are masculine: le moment, le logement, le paiement, un appartement (l'appartement).
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -ment? Then it is “le”: le moment.

rules.name: -eau
rules.rule: Nouns in -eau are masculine: le bureau, le gâteau, le bateau, le manteau. The ones to watch: la peau and une eau (l'eau).
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -eau? Then it is usually “le”: le bureau.

rules.name: -isme
rules.rule: Nouns in -isme are masculine: le tourisme, le racisme, le journalisme, le féminisme.
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -isme? Then it is “le”: le tourisme.

rules.name: -oir
rules.rule: Nouns in -oir are masculine: le soir, le couloir, le miroir, le devoir, un espoir (l'espoir).
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -oir? Then it is “le”: le soir.

rules.name: -ier
rules.rule: Nouns in -ier are masculine: le papier, le quartier, le cahier, le dossier. A person in -ier has a feminine in -ière: le caissier, la caissière.
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -ier? Then it is “le”: le papier.

rules.name: -et
rules.rule: Nouns in -et are masculine: le billet, le ticket, le jouet, le poulet, un objet (l'objet).
rules.ruleLeicht: The word ends in -et? Then it is “le”: le billet.
